ns2:section.sectionText: This lecture is reserved for students in the Division of General Studies college. SOC 100 will be fully online and asynchronous using Compass 2g. Students will be grouped by their discussion sections and will continue to have an assigned TA and an assigned discussion board group. Students will be expected to check in with their TA via the TA's scheduled Zoom hours at least once during the semester. Students will also be able to access assistance through Dr.Clarke's scheduled Zoom hours and by appointment. Students in different time zones will be accommodated as much as possible.
